system.description: An extra level of Presence unique to the Malkavian elder Jacob (of Milwaukee), Coax brings a target's own fears and desires to the surface of their mind when Jacob makes them an offer, making it very difficult to refuse. Mechanically, the target must win a resisted Self-Control/Instinct Virtue Test (Social Traits) against Jacob; if Jacob wins, the target cannot bring themselves to act against what Jacob has proposed for the remainder of the scene. This is a subtle, quiet power best resolved by the Storyteller without telegraphing its use to the player.
system.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred (Jacob/Esau)
system.duration: Until acted upon or scene ends
